en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Kamenz from the south. A curving railway line runs along the left foreground, while fields and a dirt path occupy the right. In the distance, the town's skyline is visible with a prominent large church dominating the center-right, surrounded by houses, industrial chimneys, and other buildings. The lower part of the card is blank for writing, with the caption and publisher information printed near the bottom.
